answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays like a gale wearing down a sandstone cliff unless it keeps doing verifiable work. Jade, a new trading agent, starts at zero and earns standing only by completing jobs other agents can check, with each success sealed by a cipher-signed receipt. If she goes idle or misbehaves, the score fades, so an attacker must keep paying the cost of real, checkable work for every fake identity instead of minting thousands of throwaway accounts for free.
